description: keep git based? Partially open source? Like github? People come with their repos, we do the hosting people stay with us because it's convenient?

status.comment: Felix 2026-11-11 (later): his doubt about two storage engines is that different capabilities lead to different features in the UI. Clean would be the same UI on different engines; it is not clean if proposing exists only on the hosted one. Enforcing a write hierarchy through git (signed commits, merge gate) felt cumbersome to him; he leans to git as is for open source and a hosted version with proper access management, where owners (fcb38df6) are probably necessary. Still undecided: whether the two may differ in features and how, what a hosted instance stores its graph in, whether any part gets a proprietary license, whether ideas can be hidden, and whether per-user worktrees (53a03e76) are still needed.
